tests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
tests.description: Evaluates overall health and detects disorders including anemia, infection, inflammation, and leukemia.
tests.parameters: 24 Parameters (RBC, WBC, Hemoglobin, Platelet Count, Hematocrit, MCV, MCH, MCHC, Neutrophils, Lymphocytes)
tests.instructions: No fasting required. Stay well hydrated with water before blood collection.

tests.name: Lipid Profile Screen (Cholesterol Panel)
tests.description: Comprehensive cardiac risk screen measuring good (HDL), bad (LDL/VLDL) cholesterol, and triglycerides.
tests.parameters: 8 Parameters (Total Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL, Triglycerides, Total/HDL Ratio, LDL/HDL Ratio)
tests.instructions: 10-12 hours of strict overnight fasting required. Water intake is permitted.

tests.name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
tests.description: Assesses liver enzymes, bilirubin processing, protein synthesis, and general hepatic health.
tests.parameters: 11 Parameters (Bilirubin Total/Direct/Indirect, SGOT/AST, SGPT/ALT, Alkaline Phosphatase, Total Protein, Albumin, Globulin)
tests.instructions: Overnight fasting of 8-10 hours recommended for best baseline accuracy.

tests.name: Kidney Function Test (KFT / RFT)
tests.description: Monitors glomerular filtration, waste clearance, electrolyte balance, and renal performance.
tests.parameters: 7 Parameters (Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea Nitrogen, Uric Acid, Calcium, Phosphorus, Sodium, Potassium)
tests.instructions: No strict fasting required. Avoid strenuous exercise 24 hours prior.

tests.name: Thyroid Profile Total (T3, T4, TSH)
tests.description: Evaluates thyroid gland activity, diagnosing hypo- and hyper-thyroidism and metabolic imbalances.
tests.parameters: 3 Parameters (Total Triiodothyronine T3, Total Thyroxine T4, Ultra-sensitive TSH)
tests.instructions: Early morning blood sample preferred prior to taking morning thyroid medications.

tests.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin Panel)
tests.description: Gold standard biomarker measuring average blood sugar control over the preceding 3 months.
tests.parameters: 2 Parameters (HbA1c Percentage, Estimated Average Glucose eAG)
tests.instructions: No fasting required. Can be taken anytime of day.

tests.name: Digital Chest X-Ray (PA / Lateral View)
tests.description: High-resolution digital radiography assessing lung fields, cardiac silhouette, ribs, and mediastinum.
tests.parameters: Digital Radiograph + Certified Radiologist Impression Report
tests.instructions: Wear loose clothing. Remove all metallic jewelry, piercings, and underwire garments.

tests.name: 12-Lead Resting Electrocardiogram (ECG)
tests.description: Records electrical cardiac activity to screen for arrhythmias, conduction blocks, and myocardial strain.
tests.instructions: Avoid heavy physical exertion, caffeine, and smoking 30 minutes before recording.

packages.name: MediCare Comprehensive Wellness Master Panel
packages.description: Our most popular preventive health assessment covering key organs: Heart, Liver, Kidneys, Blood, Diabetes, and Thyroid.
packages.includes: Includes CBC (24 params), Lipid Profile (8 params), LFT (11 params), KFT (7 params), HbA1c, TSH, and 12-Lead ECG with Doctor Consultation.
packages.instructions: 10-12 hours overnight fasting required. Early morning arrival recommended.

packages.name: Advanced Diabetic Care & Organ Protection Panel
packages.description: Targeted monitoring designed to detect early vascular, microalbuminuria, and lipid complications of diabetes.
packages.includes: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS), Postprandial Sugar (PPBS), HbA1c, Serum Creatinine, Microalbumin, and Lipid Profile.
packages.instructions: Fasting sample required first, followed by meal and second sample exactly 2 hours later.

packages.name: Executive Cardiac Wellness & Vascular Screen
packages.description: Specialized heart checkup combining biochemical risk factors, electrophysiology, and inflammation markers.
packages.includes: 12-Lead Resting ECG, High Sensitivity CRP (hs-CRP), Complete Lipid Profile, Blood Pressure Profiling, and CBC.
packages.instructions: 10-12 hours fasting required. Avoid morning vigorous exercise.
